gaps.detail: Physical one hundred thirty-two first says brake gently for a tire failure and then says not to brake until control is regained. The conflicting detailed sequence is withheld; steering control, gradual accelerator release and a safe exit remain.

The submerged-vehicle rear-air-pocket sequence and the tunnel instruction naming the nearest entrance as an escape route require further safety-source review and are withheld. CPR instructions cross physical pages and are not stitched into a single-page fact. Source first-aid statements are not certification or independent clinical review.

Historic crash and hit-and-run totals, fuel-cost savings, evaporation quantities, fuel-consumption percentages and comparative travel-time percentages are withheld as contextual or unverified claims. No unprinted exception to the source idling statement is invented.
